comment: Two facts hold across the whole plugin. Polyphony is handled in one shared place: every audio input is read with getVoltageSum(), which adds all sixteen channels, and every control voltage input is read a channel at a time and scaled by sapphire_vcvrack.hpp:1094, so the props cite that line rather than repeating the mechanism per module. And every attenuverter carries two right-click items of its own that change what its jack expects: Low sensitivity divides the attenuverter setting by ten (sapphire_attenuverter_context.hpp:6), so the same swing needs ten times the voltage; Unipolar mode replaces the voltage with the greater of zero and the voltage plus 5V (sapphire_attenuverter_context.hpp:26), which turns a -5 to 5V jack into a 0 to 10V one and makes anything below -5V read as zero. The ranges written in the props are the ones with both items off.
